doc: v1 cards that the v2 story rewrites (V2-10's inner voice, the new chapters): {speaker, text, cue, why}. `silent`: voice keys (assets/audio/voice/manifest.json) whose card is gone on purpose. tests/test_port.gd reads this. The port keeps v1 word for word except the sign line, the narrator (now Mano's thoughts) and some generic slang. Only unvoiced lines are reworded: every voiced v1 card is still in the data.
